description: Automated weekly blog pipeline using Claude Agent SDK. GitHub Actions cron triggers every Sunday, Agent SDK orchestrates SEO data collection (GSC + GA4 via MCP), topic selection, blog post generation, image sourcing (Pexels API + web search + branded card fallback), validation, and auto-commit to main for Vercel deploy. Reference: tasks/prd-auto-blog-pipeline.md and tasks/design-auto-blog-pipeline.md

userStories.title: Claude Agent SDK verification spike
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to verify the Claude Agent SDK works end-to-end with MCP servers before building the full pipeline. Create scripts/test-agent-sdk.js that: (1) imports from @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk (already installed), (2) calls query() with a simple prompt 'Read data/posts.json and tell me how many posts exist', (3) configures permissionMode: 'bypassPermissions' with allowDangerouslySkipPermissions: true, (4) uses model 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929', (5) sets maxTurns: 10 and maxBudgetUsd: 0.50, (6) configures GSC MCP server: { command: 'npx', args: ['-y', 'mcp-server-gsc'], env: { GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS: process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS || './gcp-credentials.json' } }, (7) configures GA4 MCP server: { command: 'npx', args: ['-y', 'mcp-server-google-analytics'], env: { GA4_PROPERTY_ID: process.env.GA_PROPERTY_ID || '523614078', GA4_CLIENT_EMAIL: process.env.GA4_CLIENT_EMAIL, GA4_PRIVATE_KEY: process.env.GA4_PRIVATE_KEY } }, (8) iterates the async generator to stream messages and log progress, (9) handles result types: SDKResultSuccess, error_max_turns, error_during_execution, error_max_budget_usd, (10) reports total_cost_usd, num_turns, duration_ms on completion, (11) exits 0 on success, 1 on failure. The SDK entry point is: import { query } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk'. The query() function returns a Query object that extends AsyncGenerator<SDKMessage>. Call .next() in a loop or use for-await-of. The final return value is SDKResultSuccess | SDKResultError. Run the test locally and confirm it works. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var before running.

userStories.title: Create GitHub Actions workflow file
userStories.description: As a site owner, I want a GitHub Actions workflow that triggers every Sunday at 11:00 UTC. Create .github/workflows/weekly-blog.yml with: (1) name: 'Weekly Blog Pipeline', (2) on.schedule cron '0 11 * * 0', (3) on.workflow_dispatch with optional inputs topic_override (string) and dry_run (boolean, default false), (4) concurrency group 'weekly-blog' with cancel-in-progress: false, (5) single job 'generate-blog' running on ubuntu-latest with timeout-minutes: 20. Job steps: checkout repo, setup node 20, npm ci, install playwright chromium (npx playwright install chromium), extract credentials from GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON secret to /tmp/gsa-credentials.json, extract client_email and private_key from the JSON into env vars GA4_CLIENT_EMAIL and GA4_PRIVATE_KEY using jq, run 'node scripts/weekly-blog-agent.js' with env vars (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/gsa-credentials.json, GA_PROPERTY_ID from secret, GA4_CLIENT_EMAIL, GA4_PRIVATE_KEY, PEXELS_API_KEY from secret, TOPIC_OVERRIDE from input, DRY_RUN from input), then if not dry_run: git config user.name 'LV Content Bot' and email 'noreply@libertyvillage.co', git pull --rebase origin main, git add specific files (data/posts.json, public/images/blog/, tasks/), git commit, git push. Final post-if:always step to clean up /tmp/gsa-credentials.json. Required secrets: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, GA_PROPERTY_ID, PEXELS_API_KEY.
